takeaway: Six structures pass under the flexor retinaculum behind the medial malleolus: Tom, Dick, And, Very, Nervous, Harry. The deep peroneal nerve is not one of them.

question.text: Which of the following structures does not travel under the flexor retinaculum behind the medial malleolus?

lines.text: Behind the medial ankle, the flexor retinaculum roofs the tarsal tunnel.
Tom, Dick and a very nervous Harry pass through it. Tom is tibialis posterior, and Dick is flexor digitorum longus.
And is the posterior tibial artery, very is the vein, and nervous is the tibial nerve.
That makes six structures under the retinaculum, from front to back.
The deep peroneal nerve is not one of them. It runs at the front of the ankle.
So the answer is the deep peroneal nerve.
